template_data.lead_html: Two years stuck on past performance. One question reframed everything.

rows.what_html: Lost every RFQ on past performance — clean SAM, right NAICS codes, zero federal wins
"Have you looked into teaming?" — partnering with a prime who already has the track record
A new strategy, not a workaround — the one door genuinely open for first-time federal entrants

template_data.closer: THE DOOR WAS OPEN. THEY JUST NEEDED A PARTNER.
